read: every member's name, unit and definition in all 20 families, and the full before/after difference of the two families the pass changed; documentation was read where a difference or a defect needed it

changes_after.current_density: fast_current_density documentation gains the word 'local'; wording only, meaning unchanged

members_wrong_before.reason: definition is the placeholder 'deterministic parent, description pending LLM enrichment'
definition says flux-surface averaged; the name carries no average while its siblings are local
definition restricts it to the component generated by parallel viscosity in the edge plasma; the name is the general radial component
defined as a scalar magnitude, while ion, Pfirsch-Schlueter, runaway and trapped current densities are defined as the vector and total_current_density as a signed projection

verdict: not accepted under the section's rule: no member sound before is wrong after, but the count of adjudicated inconsistencies does not fall. Both proposed repairs are wording-only, and the pass missed meaning-changing inconsistencies inside its own fixed classes: three unit-basis errors in one family, two names that say square while their unit and definition are an inverse square, a square-root versus linear flux-coordinate convention, and two definitions carrying a qualifier their names omit.
